scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
我該打個招呼嗎？很高興見到你。我是盧安達，這個洞穴的防禦管理員。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
For simple quests, we have prepared a request board, so you can find them and report them to me.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
對於簡單的任務，我們準備了任務板，你可以找到它們並向我彙報。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
The quest itself doesn't have to be difficult, as you just have to go around the cave and deal with the monsters or bring the byproducts of the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
任務本身不需要太難，你只需要在洞穴周圍處理魔物，或者收集魔物的副產品。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Since you've been hired by the village, I'd like you to work hard and lighten the burden a bit. It's really hard these days. Please.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
既然你被村莊僱傭了，我希望你能努力工作，減輕一點負擔。最近真的很難。拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Then have a good time. Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
那麼祝你玩得開心。冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
怎麼了，冒險者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the strange shimmering you had witnessed.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達講述了你目睹的奇怪閃光。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
A strange shimmer? As you said, it's a really strange phenomenon.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
奇怪的閃光？正如你所說，這確實是一個奇怪的現象。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I've lived in the village for a long time, but it seems like a phenomenon I've never heard of. I'm guessing, but I think it's just started happening recently.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
我在村莊住了很久，但似乎從未聽說過這種現象。我猜測，這可能是最近才開始發生的。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I don't live alone in the village, and if someone had seen it, it would have been rumored, but hearing it for the first time would make my guess clear.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
我在村莊裡不是獨居，如果有人見過，肯定會有傳聞，但這是我第一次聽到，所以我的猜測應該是正確的。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It could be dangerous, so if you find it, why don't you avoid it? There's no need to take a risk.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
這可能很危險，如果你發現了，為什麼不避開它呢？沒必要冒險。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達彙報並獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
怎麼了，冒險者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about three young men you met and talked to.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達講述了你遇到並交談的三名年輕男子。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Uh.. huh?! You saw me and young men who look like like my brothers.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
呃.. 什麼？！你看到了我和看起來像我兄弟的年輕男子。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It seems like it happened a long time ago. Unlike Mao, I don't have a very good memory.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
看來那是很久以前的事了。不像毛，我的記性不太好。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I vaguely remember it. I did warn a stranger I met before I went hunting with my brothers.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
我隱約記得。在我和兄弟們去打獵之前，我確實警告過一個陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's not uncommon to see strangers in town, so my memory is hazy, but I remember it.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
在鎮上遇到陌生人並不罕見，所以我的記憶有些模糊，但我確實記得這件事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's interesting. If what you're saying is true, doesn't that mean you've been talking to me in the past?
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
這很有趣。如果你說的是真的，那豈不是意味著你過去就已經和我交談過了？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Ah! Come to think of it, do you remember the first time we met? Didn't I say I was used to being an adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
啊！仔細想想，你還記得我們第一次見面嗎？我當時是不是說過我習慣了做冒險者？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
As expected, I don't think it was a bad feeling. I really can't believe it. An adventurer who met me in the past...
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
果然，我覺得這感覺並不壞。我真的不敢相信。一個在過去就見過我的冒險者...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
That sounds like something similar could happen in the future, right?
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
聽起來未來也可能發生類似的事情，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I apologize. Deep down, I felt that it was annoying for adventurers to talk to me. Now, I'll ask you first.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
抱歉。內心深處，我覺得冒險者來找我聊天有點煩人。現在，我先問問你。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
If you ever go through something similar, please let me know. I'm begging you.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
如果你以後遇到類似的事情，請告訴我。拜託了。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達彙報並獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
怎麼了，冒險者？

scripts.text: Told him about Karoo and Asudem.
scripts.translation: 向他講述了卡魯和阿蘇德姆的事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Puhahaha I think you came to see the place where Hyung-nim and sister-in-law are dating.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
噗哈哈，我想你是來看哥哥和嫂子約會的地方吧。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Oh my gosh.. that place is where my brother and sister-in-law often went on dates.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
天哪...那個地方是我哥哥和嫂子經常去約會的地方。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
My brother might think it's a secret place only he knows, but it's a place everyone in the village knows.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
我哥哥可能覺得那是隻有他知道的秘密地點，但村裡的人都知道那裡。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's quite a popular spot among village lovers. It's quiet and a good place for a date.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
那裡是村裡情侶們很喜歡的地方。那裡很安靜，是個約會的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Recently, I haven't had much to laugh about because of various things, but thanks to you, I laughed out loud. I look forward to the next story.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
最近因為各種事情，我沒什麼可笑的，但多虧了你，我開懷大笑。期待你的下一個故事。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達彙報並獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
怎麼了，冒險者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about who was painting murals in the cave.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達講述了是誰在洞穴裡畫壁畫。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Have you ever met me when I was painting the mural? I don't remember, but...
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
你見過我畫壁畫的時候嗎？我不記得了，但是...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I think I can tell you why I painted the mural.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
我想我可以告訴你我為什麼畫那幅壁畫。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's not much of a secret, but each of my brothers has a mysterious ability.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
這不算什麼秘密，我的每個兄弟都有神秘的能力。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
In the case of Karoo-hyung, he has the ability to see accurately even from a distance..
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
以卡魯哥哥為例，他擁有從遠處也能準確看清事物的能力...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Maknae Maru has an excellent memory that never forgets what she has seen and the ability to read her opponent's mind..
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
小妹妹瑪魯擁有過目不忘的驚人記憶力，還能讀懂對手的心思...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I'm not always correct, but I can see into the future. Ah! I have more abilities than that.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
雖然我不一定總是對的，但我能預見未來。啊！我擁有的能力遠不止這些。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I can see people's good and evil energy. In the case of adventurers...
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
我能看到人們身上的善與惡的氣息。至於冒險者...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I can feel the good energy that can't be touched. That's why I feel more bitter.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
我能感受到那種無法觸及的善意。正因如此，我感到更加苦澀。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Coming back to the original story, the reason I'm painting the mural is because one day I dreamed of a village burning down.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
回到正題，我畫這幅壁畫是因為有一天我夢見村莊被燒燬了。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Many monsters have come to town and people are crying out in pain because of it...
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
許多魔物湧入了城鎮，人們因痛苦而哀嚎...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
After the hellish dream, I saw myself recording the day's events on a mural in a cave.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
在那場噩夢之後，我看見自己正在洞穴的壁畫上記錄那天的事件。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Haha, don't worry too much. The dream hasn't happened yet.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
哈哈，別太擔心。那個夢還沒有成真。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Do you know? If I paint the mural in advance, will the future I saw in my dream change?
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
你知道嗎？如果我提前畫好這幅壁畫，我在夢中看到的未來就會改變嗎？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
An adventurer I haven't seen in my dreams is helping us, so I'm sure we can change it.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
有一位我在夢中未曾見過的冒險者在幫助我們，我相信我們一定能改變它。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達彙報並獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
怎麼了，冒險者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about Mao, who was training alone.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達講述了獨自訓練的毛。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Mao guy... you've been thinking about a lot of things.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
毛這傢伙...你最近想了很多事吧。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Brother Karu lives separately from his sister-in-law, and we still live together, but I don't think he cared too much about his sister.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
哥哥卡魯和嫂子分開住，而我們還住在一起，但我覺得他並不太在意他的妹妹。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's said that I lost my mind after having a painful dream, but somehow my anxiety...
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
據說我在做了痛苦的夢後精神失常了，但不知為何我的焦慮...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Looks like he's been infested with Mao. Maybe because of his abilities, he's often swayed by other people's emotions...
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
看來他被毛的情緒侵擾了。也許是因為他的能力，他常常被他人的情緒所左右...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
He... training to become stronger... even if he doesn't become stronger... he's still enough...
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
他...為了變強而訓練...即使他無法變強...他也已經足夠好了...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Thank you. Thanks to you, I found out about Mao's troubles.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
謝謝你。多虧了你，我才得知了毛的煩惱。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達彙報並獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
怎麼了，冒險者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about someone who was taking something from the cave.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達講述了有人從洞穴裡拿走東西的事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
You saw that too. I think we've talked about it before. In my dream, I saw monsters coming into town.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
你也看到了。我想我們之前談過。在我的夢裡，我看見魔物湧入了城鎮。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
And in preparation for that time, the village warriors evacuated the elderly and weak to this place, and they stored supplies here and there in the cave.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
為了應對那一刻，村莊的戰士們將老人和體弱者疏散到了這裡，並將物資分散存放在洞穴各處。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
These are literally emergency items. It would be perfect if they were not used, but...
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
這些是真正的應急物資。如果它們能一直不被使用，那就最好了，但是...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
You don't know how the world works. If you find something, just ignore it.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
你不懂這個世界的運作方式。如果你發現了什麼，就假裝沒看見吧。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達彙報並獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
怎麼了，冒險者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the story of meeting the villagers and the village chief.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達講述了遇見村民和村長的故事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
You really came to see what happened a while ago. It wasn't as much damage as you saw in your dream, but it was a lot of damage.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
你竟然真的去看了之前發生的事。雖然不像你在夢裡看到的那樣嚴重，但損失依然很大。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
When I think of that day, my heart hurts. All of a sudden, when my brothers were away...
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
每當想起那一天，我的心就隱隱作痛。突然之間，當我的兄弟們不在的時候...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Still, the village chief, the best elder in the village, seems to have suffered less damage because he was calm. Thanks for the story.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
不過，村長，村裡最年長的長老，似乎因為保持冷靜而受到的傷害較小。謝謝你告訴我這些。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達彙報並獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
怎麼了，冒險者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the story of meeting the brothers who ran somewhere in a hurry.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達講述了遇見匆忙離去的兄弟們的故事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
You must have seen the day my brothers and I came back from hunting. There was a big disaster in the village and it was the next day.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
你一定看到了我和兄弟們狩獵歸來後的那一天。村裡發生了大災難，而那是第二天。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Kuh.. If me and my brothers hadn't emptied the village... the people wouldn't have been taken by the monsters...
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
咳...如果我和兄弟們沒有清空村莊...人們就不會被魔物帶走...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
If so... my sister-in-law also...
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
如果是那樣...我的弟媳也會...

scripts.text: It's not your fault.
scripts.translation: 這不是你的錯。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I know. It's not because of me and my brothers.. but.. that day.. we.. .. .. it's just a pity
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
我知道。這不是我和兄弟們的錯...但是...那一天...我們... ... ...真可惜

scripts.text: You'd better calm down first.
scripts.translation: 你先冷靜一下。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
You've shown me, adventurer, something I wouldn't have seen. I'm just here to tell you what I remember...
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
冒險者，你讓我看到了我未曾見過的景象。我只是在這裡告訴你我所記得的...

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達彙報並獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
怎麼了，冒險者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the story of seeing Karu and Asudem.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達講述了看見卡魯和阿蘇德姆的故事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Ka.. Karu hyungnim.. hyungnim
That's the reason why you shut yourself up in the west cave.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
卡...卡魯兄長...兄長
這就是你把自己關在西邊洞穴裡的原因。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I feel resentful of myself for not being able to help with the village defense.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
我對自己感到怨恨，因為無法幫助村莊防禦。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Your heart... I can't even imagine your sister-in-law's... whoo... your sorrow...
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
你的心...我甚至無法想像你的弟媳的...嗚...你的悲傷...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
When the situation here is sorted out, I will look for my older brother. He must be alone in pain and sorrow.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
等這裡的情況穩定下來，我會去找我的兄長。他一定正獨自承受著痛苦和悲傷。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
My heart hurts like this too, but if you know the youngest who struggles because of his abilities... I'll have to prepare. Thank you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
我的心也這樣痛著，但如果你知道那個因自身能力而掙扎的弟弟...我必須做好準備。謝謝你，冒險者。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達彙報並獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
怎麼了，冒險者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about stories of unknown people.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達講述了關於陌生人的故事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It sounds like a conversation between a Wootan or Megalith monster targeting the village.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
聽起來像是烏坦或邪惡摩艾魔物在針對村莊的對話。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Follow a strong leader? Recently, I felt that the movements of these guys are disturbingly orderly...
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
追隨一個強大的首領？最近，我覺得這些傢伙的行動異常有序...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It seems that a monster has appeared to lead them.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
看來是出現了某種魔物在領導它們。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's embarrassing. Even now, all we can do is block it.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
真是慚愧。到現在為止，我們只能進行阻擋。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
This is not the time to be sad. We need to build more defenses and take other measures.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
現在不是悲傷的時候。我們需要建立更多的防禦措施，並採取其他手段。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
A strong leader is also a problem... but a power that has been handed down as a legend? This is a story I've never heard of before.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
強大的首領也是個問題...但作為傳說流傳下來的力量？這是我從未聽說過的故事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I'm guessing this is the reason why the monsters are attacking the village, but I'll have to tell the chief and investigate.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
我猜測這就是魔物襲擊村莊的原因，但我必須告訴首領並進行調查。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
The story you just told me was really helpful. Thank you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
你剛才告訴我的故事真的很有幫助。謝謝你，冒險者。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向盧安達彙報並獲得了經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's a situation where even one request is regrettable, but {0}... really.
You worked hard.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
即使只有一個請求也令人遺憾，但{0}...真的。
辛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Each and every request is precious. Thank you again and again.
You worked hard.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
每一個請求都很珍貴。再次感謝。
辛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
怎麼了，冒險者？

scripts.text: Is there no request here?
scripts.translation: 這裡沒有請求嗎？

scripts.text: What is this cave?
scripts.translation: 這個洞穴是什麼？

scripts.text: Why are monsters invading?
scripts.translation: 為什麼魔物會入侵？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
For quests that are recruiting in town, there is a separate request board.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
對於在城鎮招募的任務，有單獨的任務板。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Ah! Watch your mind. The location is in the middle of the battlefield, so I installed it in the corner for safety reasons.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
啊！注意你的言行。位置在戰場中央，為了安全起見，我把它安裝在角落裡了。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
There are cases where you cannot complete a request on the bulletin board right away, but there is no specific time limit, so don't be in a hurry.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
有時候你可能無法立即完成公告板上的請求，但沒有具體的時間限制，所以不用著急。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Adventurer, you are really curious about everything.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
冒險者，你真的對一切都很好奇。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
The Luanda Caves are strategically the only way out north of town.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
盧安達洞穴在戰略上是城鎮以北唯一的出口。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
That's why we're defending against monster attacks here.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
所以我們在這裡防禦魔物的襲擊。

scripts.text: Luanda Cave? Luanda?
scripts.translation: 盧安達洞穴？盧安達？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Ah! Did you notice? Yes, my name is Luanda too. The village elders say...
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
啊！你注意到了嗎？是的，我的名字也叫盧安達。村裡的長老們說...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
The triplets are said to have been named Karu, Luanda, and Mao after the village caves.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
據說三胞胎的名字卡魯、盧安達和毛，是以村裡的洞穴命名的。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
My neighborhood friends teased me a bit when I was young, but I don't have any complaints about the name.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
小時候鄰居朋友稍微取笑過我，但我對這個名字並不介意。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I heard they were named after the guardians of the village. I'm rather proud of them.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
我聽說他們是以村莊的守護者命名的。我對此感到相當自豪。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's very puzzling to us too. If we knew why, we'd have put everything away.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
這讓我們也很困惑。如果我們知道原因，早就把一切收拾好了。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
This isn't a town with plenty of food, and I don't think there's any particular reason for monsters to target it.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
這裡並不是食物豐富的城鎮，我認為魔物也沒有特別針對這裡的理由。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
But what can we do? We're just living here, and the monsters keep coming, so we have to live while blocking them.
scripts.translation:
[盧安達]
但我們能怎麼辦呢？我們就住在這裡，魔物不斷來襲，所以我們必須一邊抵擋它們一邊生活。

scripts.text: It's a bizarre shimmer that you're likely to be sucked into.
scripts.translation: 這是一種奇異的閃光，你很可能被吸進去。

scripts.text: It seems like a phenomenon that can't be ignored. I'll have to talk to Luanda, the head of defense.

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Um... Uhm...

[Jerrymon]
Oh, what a surprise!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
哦，真是驚喜！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
What's up? I'm busy right now, so I'll talk to you later.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
什麼事？我現在很忙，稍後再和你談。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Um... Uhm...

[Jerrymon]
Oh, what a surprise!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
哦，真是驚喜！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
What's up? I'm a bit busy right now...
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
什麼事？我現在有點忙...

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Ah, you're the one introduced by Raket. I've been waiting for you.
Can you show me your fishing rod?
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
啊，你是拉凱特介紹來的。我一直在等你。
能給我看看你的魚竿嗎？

scripts.text: - Jerrymon began to examine the rod closely. -
scripts.translation: - 傑裡蒙開始仔細檢查魚竿。 -

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes, that's right... this substance is just that... to discover it again like this...
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
是的，沒錯...這種物質就是那個...再次發現它...

scripts.text: What material are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你說的是什麼材料？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Adventurer, do you know where the deepest part of the sea is?
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
冒險者，你知道大海最深處的地方在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text: Well...??

[Jerrymon]
It is a place called the ^4d4dffTrench^000000. To put it simply, you can think of it as a deep cliff in the sea.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
那個地方叫做^4d4dff海溝^000000。簡單來說，你可以把它想像成海洋中深邃的懸崖。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
It is known that there are hundreds of different types of trenches in the world's oceans.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
已知世界海洋中存在數百種不同型別的海溝。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The widest and deepest known trench is the ^4d4dffBahia Trench^000000 near Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
已知最寬且最深的海溝是位於依斯魯得島附近的^4d4dff巴伊亞海溝^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
There are rare life forms at the bottom of the trench, and marine scientists like myself have shown great interest and have been exploring them.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
海溝底部存在著罕見的生物，像我這樣的海洋科學家對此非常感興趣，並一直在進行探索。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Though shallow trenches can be explored to some extent.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
雖然淺海溝可以在一定程度上被探索。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
But in the case of the Bahia Trench, scientists have calculated that scientifically, no life can exist because it is so incredibly deep.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
但就巴伊亞海溝而言，科學家計算出，由於它深不可測，從科學上講那裡不可能存在生命。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I recently found out that there is life in the Bahia Trench.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
我最近發現巴伊亞海溝中確實存在生命。

scripts.text: How do you know that??
scripts.translation: 你怎麼知道的？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
You can tell by the stone that contains my magic.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
通過蘊含我魔法的石頭就能看出來。

scripts.text: A stone with magical power?
scripts.translation: 帶有魔力的石頭？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes, I'm a mage-turned-oceanographer. I learned magic for oceanography.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
是的，我是轉行做海洋研究的魔法師。我學習魔法是為了進行海洋研究。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Enchant a large boulder and make it fall to the floor where the trench exists.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
給一塊巨石施加魔法，讓它沉入海溝底部。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The magic on the dropped stone is connected to me, so by measuring the distance, I can get a little idea of how deep it is and what's going on near the stone.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
沉入水中的石頭上的魔法與我相連，通過測量距離，我就能大致瞭解那裡的深度以及石頭附近的情況。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
To tell you what I found out...
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
讓我告訴你我的發現...

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The composition of normal sea water and deep sea water is almost the same. But the only difference is the deep sea of Bahia Trench.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
普通海水的成分與深海海水幾乎相同。但唯一的例外是巴伊亞海溝的深海區域。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Should I say it's like water and oil? There's a section where they never mix.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
該怎麼說呢，就像水和油一樣？那裡有一層它們永遠不會混合的分界線。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
A strong boundary was formed where they meet each other, and it felt as if the deep seawater in that section was desperately blocking the seawater coming down from above.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
在它們相遇的地方形成了一道強烈的屏障，感覺那裡的深海海水正在拼命阻擋從上方降下來的海水。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The water pressure is also much lower than that of normal seawater, so it is assumed that it has a favorable environment for life.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
那裡的水壓也比普通海水低得多，因此推測那裡擁有適合生命生存的環境。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
We call it ^4d4dffdeep seawater^000000
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
我們稱之為^4d4dff深海海水^000000

scripts.text: Is this gloss related to what you said?
scripts.translation: 這種光澤與你剛才說的那件事有關嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes! That's right!!
We only identified the existence of Abyssal Seawater deep in the Bahia Trench, and it was very difficult to obtain samples. This fishing rod has a lot of Abyssal Seawater on it...
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
沒錯！就是這樣！！
我們只在巴伊亞海溝深處確認了深淵海水的存在，而且很難獲取樣本。這根魚竿上沾了很多深淵海水...

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Could you leave this fishing rod with me? I think I can figure something out if I extract this sea water and turn it into essence.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
能把這根魚竿留給我嗎？我覺得如果提取出這些海水並製成精華，應該能發現些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Oh, and I heard that the fishing rod was found today. Can I ask you to check if there is another floating substance in the nearby sea?
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
哦對了，我聽說這根魚竿是今天被發現的。能請你檢查一下附近海域是否還有漂浮物嗎？

scripts.text: Okay, I'll be back.
scripts.translation: 好的，我馬上回來。

scripts.text: I'm a bit busy right now...
scripts.translation: 我現在有點忙...

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please come back to me when you're done!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
忙完請回來找我！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes, thanks! I'll be waiting for you!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
好的，謝謝！我會在這裡等你的！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
抱歉打擾你了，拜託了。我會在這裡等你的。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
抱歉打擾你了，拜託了。我會在這裡等你的。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Ah, welcome, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
啊，歡迎回來，冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The investigation is going smoothly~
Hey, could you take a look at this?
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
調查進展得很順利~
嘿，你能看一下這個嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
See those two little water bottles here?
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
看到這兩個小水瓶了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
One side is normal seawater, and the other side is seawater mixed with seawater from the abyss buried in fishing rods. I'll try mixing these two.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
一邊是普通海水，另一邊是混合了魚竿上深淵海水的海水。我要試著把這兩者混合起來。

scripts.text: - Jerrymon poured both waters into one bottle and began to shake them together. -
scripts.translation: - 傑裡蒙將兩種水倒入同一個瓶子中，開始搖晃混合。 -

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Now, look. As I said before, they don't mix at all, do they?
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
現在，看。就像我之前說的，它們完全不會混合，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
This... this!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
這...這！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
If you shake it like crazy!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
如果拼命搖晃的話！！

scripts.text: [Jerrymon] Wow!!!!!!
scripts.translation: [傑裡蒙] 哇！！！！！！

scripts.text: [Jerrymon] Uwachachaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!!!!!
scripts.translation: [傑裡蒙] 烏哇恰恰恰恰恰恰恰恰！！！！！！

scripts.text: [Jerrymon] Ahhhhhhh!!!!!!
scripts.translation: [傑裡蒙] 啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh...
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊...

scripts.text: Oh, I'm going to catch someone, is it okay?
scripts.translation: 哦，我要去抓人了，可以嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Keep... Whoa... Whoa... OK now.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
停...哇...哇...好了。

scripts.text: - Looking into the bottle Jerrymon is holding, I can clearly see the shape of the vortex. -
scripts.translation: - 看著傑裡蒙手中的瓶子，我能清晰地看到漩渦的形狀。 -

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Now, do you see this whirlpool!! This is the passage that connects to the bottom of the Bahia Trench!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
現在，你看到這個漩渦了嗎！！這是通往巴西亞海溝底部的通道！

scripts.text: ??? Isn't that just a whirlpool created by shaking it?
scripts.translation: ??? 那不就是搖晃產生的漩渦嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
No. This is the stone that contains my magical power. Let's look at it.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
不。這是蘊含我魔力的石頭。讓我們來看看。

scripts.text: - Jerrymon put a glowing stone into the bottle. The glowing stone was sucked into the whirlpool inside the bottle and disappeared without a trace! -
scripts.translation: - 傑裡蒙將發光的石頭放入瓶中。發光的石頭被瓶中的漩渦吸入，消失得無影無蹤！ -

scripts.text: No, how could it be?
scripts.translation: 不，怎麼可能？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Did I ever tell you that the stone that contains my magic can measure the distance to me?
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
我有沒有告訴過你，蘊含我魔力的石頭可以測量與我之間的距離？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
It feels the same as the last time I threw a pebble into the Bahia Trench..
If you follow this whirlpool, you may be able to find the owner of the fishing rod.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
感覺和我上次往巴西亞海溝裡扔石子時一樣。
如果順著這個漩渦走，也許能找到那根釣竿的主人。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The problem is... the amount of essence on a fishing rod can't make a whirlpool large enough for a person to fit in.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
問題是...釣竿上的精華量不足以產生一個能容納人的漩渦。

scripts.text: Is this amount okay?
scripts.translation: 這個量夠嗎？

scripts.text: - Showed the ^4d4dff{0}^000000 received from Gein to Jerrymon. -
scripts.translation: - 向傑裡蒙展示了從蓋因那裡獲得的 ^4d4dff{0}^000000。 -

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Oh, just in case, I actually found it!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
哦，剛好夠用，我找到了！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
With this amount, I think I can create a vortex of fissures that normal people can enter. You can pass it to me.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
用這個量，我覺得可以製造出一個普通人也能進入的裂隙漩渦。你可以把它交給我。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The place is too small to do this much here, so let's do it in Izlude. In order to get help from your friends.
Then see you in Izlude!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
這裡地方太小，沒法施展這麼大的法術，我們去依斯魯得島吧。順便也去尋求你朋友們的幫助。
那麼，依斯魯得島見！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Then let's meet in Izlude!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
那麼，依斯魯得島見！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
抱歉打擾你了，拜託了。我會在這裡等你的。

scripts.text:
[Sirood]
Thank you very much, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[西魯德]
非常感謝你，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Sirood]
I thought I'd never come back...
scripts.translation:
[西魯德]
我本以為再也回不來了...

scripts.text:
[Soup]
Hello, my name is Soup, a friend of Sirood who is missing.
scripts.translation:
[湯]
你好，我叫湯，是西魯德失蹤的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
The four of us, Sirood, Raket, Gein, and I often enjoyed fishing.
scripts.translation:
[湯]
我們四個，西魯德、拉凱特、蓋因和我，經常一起釣魚。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
That windy day... I had been feeling very guilty for not stopping Sirood from going fishing.
scripts.translation:
[湯]
那個颳風的日子...我一直很自責，沒有阻止西魯德去釣魚。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
When I heard that Sirood's fishing pole was found, I jumped out.
scripts.translation:
[湯]
當我聽說找到了西魯德的魚竿時，我一下子跳了起來。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
You must have a clue about something?
scripts.translation:
[湯]
你一定知道些什麼線索吧？

scripts.text:
[Soup]
I did my best.
scripts.translation:
[湯]
我已經盡力了。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
Should Sirood come back safely?
scripts.translation:
[湯]
希望西魯德能平安歸來。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
Sirood is back with us.
scripts.translation:
[湯]
西魯德回來了。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
Thanks to you, adventurer. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[湯]
謝謝你，冒險者。非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
It's been exactly 3 months since Sirood went missing.
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
西魯德失蹤已經整整三個月了。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Sirood's fishing rod was found.
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
找到了西魯德的魚竿。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
I felt that way.
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
我有這種感覺。

scripts.text: What do you think?
scripts.translation: 你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Why is this only discovered now, isn't this a message from someone?
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
為什麼現在才發現？這難道不是某人留下的資訊嗎？

scripts.text: Looking at it, it doesn't make sense.
scripts.translation: 看起來毫無道理。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Ha... It's just my delusion. I especially miss that child today.
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
哈...只是我的錯覺罷了。今天格外想念那個孩子。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Heh heh... It's so hard to use all your strength...
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
呵呵...用盡全力真是不容易...

scripts.text:
[Raket]
But for Sirood's sake...
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
但為了西魯德...

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Thank you so much!!
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
非常感謝！！

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Now you can fish with Sirood again.
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
現在你可以和西魯德一起釣魚了。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
I'm so glad...
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
真高興...

scripts.text:
You have too many items.
Please clean up your items and try again.
scripts.translation:
您的物品欄已滿。
請整理物品後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Haha... why did this only get discovered now??
It's impossible, this is...
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
哈哈...為什麼現在才發現這個？？
這不可能，這是...

scripts.text: - I feel serious anguish from this person. Let's come back after I've become level 140. -
scripts.translation: - 我感受到這個人深深的痛苦。等我升到140級再回來吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Haha...why did this only get discovered now??
It's impossible, this is...
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
哈哈...為什麼現在才發現這個？？
這不可能，這是...

scripts.text: Do you have any concerns?
scripts.translation: 你有什麼顧慮嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Oh, hello...
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
哦，你好...

scripts.text: - He is very fidgety with a fishing pole in his hand. It doesn't look like he's out fishing. -
scripts.translation: - 他手裡拿著釣竿，坐立不安。看起來不像是出來釣魚的。 -

scripts.text: [Gein] This fishing rod belongs to my friend Sirood who went missing three months ago. I found something!!!
scripts.translation: [蓋因] 這根釣竿屬於我三個月前失蹤的朋友西魯德。我發現了什麼！！！

scripts.text: Disappeared?
scripts.translation: 失蹤了？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Yes... Sirood is a fishing fanatic and came here to fish whenever he had a chance.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
是的...西魯德是個釣魚狂人，只要有空就會來這裡釣魚。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Influenced by Sirood, we also fell in love with fishing, and the four of us often had a good time.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
受西魯德的影響，我們也愛上了釣魚，我們四個經常一起度過愉快的時光。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Sirood's passion for fishing was to the point that he invited us to go fishing even in the rain and wind.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
西魯德對釣魚的熱情到了極點，甚至邀請我們在風雨天也去釣魚。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
The day Sirood went missing was exactly the same rainy and windy day. I put on my raincoat and went to go fishing.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
西魯德失蹤的那天，正好也是這樣一個風雨交加的日子。我穿上雨衣，準備去釣魚。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
We were invited to go out together, but they all declined.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
我們被邀請一起出去，但大家都拒絕了。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Sirood went fishing alone and we haven't seen him since...
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
西魯德獨自去釣魚，從那以後我們就再也沒見過他...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
I should have stopped you from leaving...
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
我應該攔住你離開的...

scripts.text: - Gein started talking again after wiping away tears for a moment. -
scripts.translation: - 蓋因擦去眼淚後，又開始說話了。 -

scripts.text:
[Gein]
The news of Sirood's disappearance immediately spread throughout Izlude and a large-scale search was conducted with a lot of time and manpower invested, but the search ended without finding any clues.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
西魯德失蹤的訊息很快傳遍了依斯魯得島，投入了大量時間和人力進行大規模搜尋，但搜尋最終沒有發現任何線索。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
After that, we got together and ran everywhere to find Sirood, but there was no result, and we were about to give up.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
之後，我們聚在一起到處尋找西魯德，但毫無結果，我們幾乎要放棄了。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
But just now!!
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
但是就在剛才！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
After 3 months!!!
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
在三個月之後！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Sirood's fishing pole has risen above sea level. His item was nowhere to be found during the search!
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
西魯德的釣竿浮出了海面。之前的搜尋中完全沒有發現他的任何物品！

scripts.text: Now, calm down... Are you sure it's Sirood's fishing rod?
scripts.translation: 現在，冷靜一下...你確定那是西魯德的釣竿嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Yes, I'm sure! It's the fishing rod I've always seen.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
是的，我確定！那就是我一直看到的那根釣竿。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
This fishing rod was made by Sirood himself, so it is the only one. You can see the initials on the handle here, S.R.D!!
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
這根釣竿是西魯德親手製作的，所以是獨一無二的。你可以看到手柄上刻著縮寫，S.R.D！！

scripts.text: Oh, then why now...
scripts.translation: 噢，那為什麼是現在...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
I'm so surprised and shocked right now that I don't know what to do.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
我現在太驚訝和震驚了，都不知道該怎麼辦。

scripts.text: - But looking closely at the fishing rod, I feel something different. This wooden fishing rod has been submerged in water for 3 months, but it still looks the same, and I can see a bit of shiny gloss... -
scripts.translation: - 但仔細看著那根釣竿，我感到有些不同。這根木製釣竿在水中浸泡了三個月，但看起來依然如新，甚至還能看到一點光澤... -

scripts.text: Isn't this fishing rod a bit strange over there?
scripts.translation: 這根釣竿那裡有點奇怪？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Strange, what is it?
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
奇怪？哪裡奇怪？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Uh...

[Gein]
Uh.....??

[Gein]
It's been submerged in water for 3 months... but it hasn't corroded at all. It's completely fine??
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
它在水中浸泡了三個月...但完全沒有腐蝕。完好無損？？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Hmm... And it seems to have a subtle glow... It seems like the fishing rod is coated?
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
嗯...而且似乎有一種微弱的光芒...看起來像是釣竿被什麼東西包裹著？

scripts.text: -The person who seemed to be Gein's friend who was listening to the story opened his mouth. -
scripts.translation: - 那個似乎是蓋因的朋友，一直在聽故事的人開了口。 -

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Where is it, I want to see it!! What's wrong??
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
在哪裡，我想看看！！怎麼了？？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
This fishing rod... It was submerged in the water for 3 months, but it was found in its original form, or worse, in a state of disrepair.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
這根釣竿...它在水中浸泡了三個月，但被發現時依然保持原樣，甚至可以說比之前更完好。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
嘖...

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Um...
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
嗯...

scripts.text: - Raket looked intently at his fishing pole, then answered Gein. -
scripts.translation: - 拉凱特盯著他的釣竿看了一會兒，然後回答蓋因。 -

scripts.text:
[Raket]
I'm not sure either?
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
我也不太確定？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Certainly!! I don't know, but would you?
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
當然！！我不知道，但你會知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Ummm... but I know someone who might know a little about this rod.
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
嗯...不過我認識一個人，他可能對這根釣竿瞭解一些。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Who??
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
是誰？？

scripts.text: Who?
scripts.translation: 誰？

scripts.text: [Raket] His name is Jerrymon, a marine scientist. I've met my father a few times. I know you are in the East Library of Prontera.
scripts.translation: [拉凱特] 他叫傑裡蒙，是一位海洋科學家。我見過我父親幾次。我知道你在普隆德拉的東圖書館。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Ah, ah... then... hey adventurer!! I'm sorry for the first meeting, but can I ask you a favor?? We can't get out of here in Izlude...
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
啊，啊...那麼...嘿，冒險者！！初次見面請多關照，能請你幫個忙嗎？？我們在依斯魯得島出不去...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Please go see Jerrymon and show him this fishing rod...even if it's trivial...I hope he has some information..
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
請去找傑裡蒙看看，給他看看這根釣竿...即使只是小事...希望他能提供一些資訊..

scripts.text: Okay. Let's go.
scripts.translation: 好的。我們走吧。

scripts.text: Sorry. I'm a bit busy right now...
scripts.translation: 抱歉。我現在有點忙...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
No... are you sure?
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
不...你確定嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Are you turning around after hearing about this heartbreaking story and mysterious clue...
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
聽完這個令人心碎的故事和神秘的線索，你就要轉身離開嗎...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Ugh... Thanks!
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
嘖...謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
^4d4dffJerrymon^000000 should still be at the <NAVI>[East Library]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI> in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
^4d4dff傑裡蒙^000000應該還在普隆德拉的<NAVI>[東圖書館]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Now, I'll give you the fishing rod, a keepsake from Sirood. Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
現在，我把這根釣竿交給你，這是西魯德的紀念品。謝謝你...

scripts.text:
[Raket]
What??? It's a keepsake!! You don't even know if Sirood is alive or dead!!
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
什麼？？那是紀念品！！你甚至不知道西魯德是死是活！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Uhhh... yes I made a mistake, this is the fishing rod Sirood left behind. Please take good care of it.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
呃...是的，我搞錯了，這是西魯德留下的釣竿。請好好保管它。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
I'll tell Jerrymon about the contents in advance through my father!
scripts.translation:
[拉凱特]
我會通過我父親提前告訴傑裡蒙裡面的內容！

scripts.text:
[Gein & Raket & Soup]
Thank you!!!
scripts.translation:
[蓋因、拉凱特與湯]
謝謝！！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
You can go to Prontera's <NAVI>[East Library]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI> as Raket told you.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
你可以像拉凱特說的那樣，去普隆德拉的<NAVI>[東圖書館]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Take care of yourself!! I hope there is even the smallest clue...
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
請多保重！！希望哪怕只有一點點線索也好...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Ah, you're here!!!
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
啊，你來了！！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Do you have any information about Sirood?
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
你有關於西魯德的訊息嗎？

scripts.text: - I relayed what I heard from Jerrymon. -
scripts.translation: - 我轉述了從傑裡蒙那裡聽到的內容。 -

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Ah... I see, I've never heard of a trench before.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
啊...原來如此，我以前從未聽說過什麼海溝。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
I can't believe there's such a big and deep trench near Izlude...
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
真不敢相信，依斯魯得島附近竟然有這麼大、這麼深的海溝...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Oh, by the way, is there anything else you need for coming back here?
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
對了，你回來這裡還需要其他什麼東西嗎？

scripts.text: I was wondering if there was anything else found besides the fishing rod.
scripts.translation: 我想問問除了釣竿之外，是否還發現了其他東西。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Oh right!!
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
啊，對了！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
It's a chunk scooped up with a landing net near where the fishing rod was found.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
是在發現釣竿的地方附近，用抄網撈上來的一塊東西。

scripts.text:
- This lump is what Jerrymon said.
^4d4dffIt must be the essence of the abyss^000000. -
scripts.translation:
- 這就是傑裡蒙所說的那個東西。
^4d4dff它一定是深淵的精華^000000。 -

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Something shiny and has the same feeling of Sirood's fishing rod, so I secured it for now.
Could this nugget help?
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
它閃閃發光，和西魯德的釣竿給人的感覺一樣，所以我先把它保管起來了。
這塊東西會有幫助嗎？

scripts.text: Thanks, that would be a great help.
scripts.translation: 謝謝，這會很有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Are you going back to Jerrymon? Please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
你要回傑裡蒙那裡嗎？請小心。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
I hope Sirood will appear in front of us intact, just as the fishing rod appeared intact...
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
希望西魯德能像釣竿那樣完好無損地出現在我們面前...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Please let me know if you have any new information!
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
如果你有任何新訊息，請告訴我！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Heh...heh...Hello adventurer, heh...heh... I'm so tired I can't move...
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
嘿...嘿...你好冒險者，嘿...嘿...我累得動不了了...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Thank you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
謝謝你，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
To be able to meet Sirood again is like a dream.
scripts.translation:
[蓋因]
能再次見到西魯德，簡直像做夢一樣。

scripts.text:
You have too many items.
Please clean up your items and try again.
scripts.translation:
您的物品欄已滿。
請整理物品後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Wow... this purple sea... it's fantastic!!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
哇...這片紫色的海洋...太壯觀了！！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
It's so amazing that we can breathe without gills, there's no sea pressure, and even marine life that I've never seen before...!!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
不用鰓就能呼吸，沒有海水壓力，甚至還有我從未見過的海洋生物...！！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
There's more than one or two things to look into, I'll be busy.
Wow... so exciting!!! I think this is the most thrilling moment in my 14 years as an oceanographer!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
要研究的東西太多了，我會很忙的。
哇...太令人興奮了！！！我想這是我14年海洋學家生涯中最激動人心的時刻！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Lululala~~~
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
啦啦啦~~~

scripts.text: Oh hey, I'm here to find Sirood...
scripts.translation: 哦，我是來找西魯德的...

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Ah, ah... that, right? That should take precedence.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
啊，啊...對，沒錯。那件事應該優先處理。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
In order to bring Sirood back ashore, we need an additional ^4d4dff{0}^000000. The question is how to get it...
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
為了把西魯德帶回陸地，我們需要額外的^4d4dff{0}^000000。問題是該如何獲取...

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I've been watching the deep sea creatures here, and I've seen some of them glow with the essence of the abyss.
And they seem to threaten us sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
我一直在觀察這裡的深海生物，發現有些會散發出深淵精華的光芒。
而且它們有時會威脅到我們。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
In that sense, could you handle some of the deep sea creatures? Maybe we can get ^4d4dff{0}^000000 from them.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
從這個角度看，你能處理一些深海生物嗎？也許我們可以從它們身上獲得^4d4dff{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please take out 10 each of ^4d4dff{0}^000000, ^4d4dff{1}^000000, and ^4d4dff{2}^000000.
Okay
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: I'll do it next time
scripts.translation: 我下次再來

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes yes~ I'll be waiting for you here!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
好的好的~我會在這裡等你的！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes yes~ I'll be waiting for you here!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
好的好的~我會在這裡等你的！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please take out 10 each of ^4d4dff{0}^000000, ^4d4dff{1}^000000, and ^4d4dff{2}^000000.

[Jerrymon]
I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
我會在這裡等你的。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Thank you for your hard work, you also brought ^4d4dff{0}^000000!! As expected, my prediction was correct.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
辛苦你了，你還帶來了^4d4dff{0}^000000！！正如我所預測的那樣。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
It looks like we only need about 10 ^4d4dff{0}^000000 to send Sirood back ashore.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
看來只需要大約10個^4d4dff{0}^000000就能把西魯德帶回陸地了。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
If you collect them, I'll create a whirlpool for you.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
如果你收集好了，我會為你製造一個漩渦。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Oh, and this is a stone I found while researching. I've been keeping it because it looks like something that could be used by adventurers, so please take it.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
哦，這是我研究時撿到的一塊石頭。我覺得它可能對冒險者有用，所以一直留著，請收下吧。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
那麼，請小心！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please bring ^4d4dff10 {0}^000000.

[Jerrymon]
I'd like to save it myself, but as you can see I'm weak, heck.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
我想自己救他，但你也看到了，我很弱，唉。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Thank you for your hard work!! You brought 10 ^4d4dff{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
辛苦你了！！你帶來了10個^4d4dff{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Would you like to go ashore now?
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
您現在想上岸嗎？

scripts.text: Go ashore
scripts.translation: 上岸

scripts.text: Not going up now
scripts.translation: 現在不上岸

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Talk to me when you're ready to go ashore!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
準備好上岸時請告訴我！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I found this again while waiting for adventurer. Please accept it!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
在等待冒險者時我又發現了這個。請收下！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Okay, let's condense this...
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
好，讓我們凝聚一下...

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Huh...!!

[Jerrymon]
Now, Adventurer and Sirood!! Can you help me?? Ehhh!!!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
現在，冒險者和西魯德！！能幫幫我嗎？？啊啊啊！！

scripts.text: - A huge whirlpool was created in front of Jerrymon! -
scripts.translation: - 傑裡蒙面前出現了一個巨大的漩渦！ -

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Then I'll cross first!!! Follow me carefully!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
那我先過去！！！請小心跟隨我！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I have everything I need for today's survey, thank you!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
我已經收集齊了今天調查所需的一切，謝謝！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Looks like you've finished your business. Would you like to move to Izlude?
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
看來您辦完事了。您想去依斯魯得島嗎？

scripts.text: Move
scripts.translation: 前往

scripts.text: Do not move
scripts.translation: 不要移動

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please let me know if you need any help!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
如果您需要幫助，請告訴我！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Okay, huh!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
好的，嗯！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'm going to cross~~ Ah!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
我要過去了~~ 啊！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Hello, research is going well.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
你好，研究進展順利。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
If we do well, we might be able to make the vortex linking here and Izlude last forever!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
如果順利的話，我們也許能讓連線這裡和依斯魯得島的漩渦永遠存在！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
So, can you help me a bit more?
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
那麼，你能再幫我一點忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I need more ^4d4dff{0}^000000, and I'd like you to take care of the ^4d4dffDeep Sea Creatures^000000 that get in the way of my research.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
我還需要更多^4d4dff{0}^000000，另外請幫我處理一下妨礙我研究的^4d4dff深海生物^000000。

scripts.text: Okay
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: I'll do it next time
scripts.translation: 我下次再來

scripts.text: I want to go back to Izlude
scripts.translation: 我想回依斯魯得島

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Thanks!! Can you do something for me?
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
謝謝！！能幫我做點事嗎？

scripts.text: Next time.
scripts.translation: 下次吧

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
^4d4dff{0}^000000 can be obtained from all the deep sea creatures here.
I need 10 right now.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
^4d4dff{0}^000000可以從這裡所有的深海生物身上獲得。
我現在需要10個。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Then take care of yourself~~!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
那麼請多保重~~！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I need 10 ^4d4dff{0}^000000.

[Jerrymon]
Come back to me when you've collected all the essences!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
收集齊所有的精華後回來找我！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
You've collected all the {0}!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
你收集齊了所有的{0}！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Thank you, I'll put it to good use in my research.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
謝謝你，我會好好用在研究上的。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please kill 10 each of ^4d4dff{0}^000000, ^4d4dff{1}^000000 and ^4d4dff{2}^000000 that roam around here.

[Jerrymon]
Then take care of yourself~~!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
那麼請多保重~~！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please kill 10 each of ^4d4dff{0}^000000, ^4d4dff{1}^000000, and ^4d4dff{2}^000000.

[Jerrymon]
You've finished dealing with all the deep sea creatures, thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
你處理完了所有的深海生物，謝謝你的辛苦工作。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'll get back to you if I need help. Thanks!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
如果還需要幫忙我會再聯絡你的。謝謝！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The only person I can ask for is you...
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
我能求助的人只有你...

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Feel free to tell me if you change your mind!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
如果你改變主意了，請隨時告訴我！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'll be staying here for a while, so let me know if you change your mind!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
我會在這裡待一段時間，如果你改變主意了請告訴我！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Okay, huh!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
好的，嗯！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'm going to cross~~ Ah!!
scripts.translation:
[傑裡蒙]
我要過去了~~ 啊！！

scripts.text:
[???]
Hello.
scripts.translation:
[簡]
你好。

scripts.text: Are you Sirood?
scripts.translation: 你是西魯德嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jane]
No, my name is Jane.
scripts.translation:
[簡]
不，我叫簡。

scripts.text:
[Jane]
Sirood...?
I think I've heard that name somewhere...
scripts.translation:
[簡]
西魯德...？
我好像在哪裡聽過這個名字...

scripts.text:
[Jane]
Hello, it looks like you've been here a while...
scripts.translation:
[簡]
你好，看起來你已經在這裡待了一會兒了...

scripts.text:
[Jane]
How do you like it? Isn't this a pretty charming place too?
scripts.translation:
[簡]
感覺如何？這裡也很迷人吧？

scripts.text:
[Jane]
I should go back to my hometown...
scripts.translation:
[簡]
我該回我的家鄉了...

scripts.text:
[???]
You said you were looking for someone named Sirood?
scripts.translation:
[孫琳]
你說過你在找一個叫西魯德的人？

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
My name is Sunrin.
scripts.translation:
[孫琳]
我叫孫琳。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
Sirood... ah, I think I know who it is.
scripts.translation:
[孫琳]
西魯德...啊，我想我知道是誰了。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
Go all the way to the left, and you'll find him.
scripts.translation:
[孫琳]
一直往左走，就能找到他。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
Then have a nice day today!!
scripts.translation:
[孫琳]
祝你今天愉快！！

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
All the people here are immigrants and settlers.
scripts.translation:
[孫琳]
這裡的人都是移民和定居者。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
As you can see, there are traces of civilization in these depths, but everyone here was an outsider.
scripts.translation:
[孫琳]
如你所見，這些深處也有文明的痕跡，但這裡的人都是外來者。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
You'll get used to it soon.
scripts.translation:
[孫琳]
你很快就會習慣的。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
Sea monsters do attack from time to time, but that's about it...
scripts.translation:
[孫琳]
海怪偶爾會襲擊，但也就這樣了...

scripts.text:
[Nick]
How is it? Is it worth living here?
scripts.translation:
[尼克]
感覺如何？值得在這裡生活嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nick]
It's deeper here than anywhere else, and it's amazing to be able to breathe freely.
I'm not sure how that works.
scripts.translation:
[尼克]
這裡比別處更深，能自由呼吸真是不可思議。
我不太明白這是怎麼回事。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Your strength isn't enough to cross to the lower levels.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
你的力量不足以前往下層。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Please come back after you are at least level 180.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
請至少達到180級後再來。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
If you go downstairs, you will run into some pretty vicious fish. Would that be alright?
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
如果你下樓，會遇到一些相當兇猛的魚。這樣可以嗎？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: I'll come next time
scripts.translation: 下次再來

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Please talk to me again when you are ready to cross.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
準備好通過時，請再和我談談。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Then be careful.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
那麼請小心。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Hello, would you like to go upstairs again?
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
你好，你想再上樓嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Please talk to me again when you are ready to cross.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
準備好通過時，請再和我談談。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Then be careful.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
那麼請小心。

scripts.text:
You have too many items.
Please clean up your items and try again.
scripts.translation:
您的物品欄已滿。
請整理物品後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Thank you for your hard work. Take a good rest today and visit us tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[凱娜]
感謝你的辛勤工作。今天好好休息，明天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Hello, Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[凱娜]
你好，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
I heard that there are many dangerous deep-sea creatures in the lower layer, but when I came here, they were more dangerous than I thought.
scripts.translation:
[凱娜]
我聽說下層有很多危險的深海生物，但當我來到這裡時，發現它們比我想像的還要危險。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Not too long ago, there was a lot of uproar when a creature from the lower layer came up to the upper layer.
scripts.translation:
[凱娜]
不久前，下層的一個生物爬到了上層，引起了很大的騷動。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
The population of deep sea creatures is increasing. Adventurer, may I ask for your help?
scripts.translation:
[凱娜]
深海生物的數量正在增加。冒險者，能請你幫個忙嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Oops...
scripts.translation:
[凱娜]
哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Kena]
It would be dangerous if left unattended...
scripts.translation:
[凱娜]
如果不加處理會很危險...

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Thank you, I'd appreciate it if you could help me defeat the deep sea creatures or fishmen.
scripts.translation:
[凱娜]
謝謝，如果你能幫我擊敗深海生物或魚人，我會很感激的。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
What would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[凱娜]
你想做什麼？

scripts.text: Next time.
scripts.translation: 下次吧

scripts.text:
[Kena]
I think this is enough for today, please come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[凱娜]
我想今天到這裡就夠了，請明天再來。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Please kill 10 each of ^4d4dff{0}^000000, ^4d4dff{1}^000000, and ^4d4dff{2}^000000.

[Kena]
These monsters are quite ferocious, so be very careful.
scripts.translation:
[凱娜]
這些魔物相當兇猛，請非常小心。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[凱娜]
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Please kill 10 of each.
scripts.translation:
[凱娜]
請各擊殺10只。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
They've all been eliminated, thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[凱娜]
它們都被消滅了，謝謝你的辛勤工作。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
If you have time, please come back tomorrow. I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[凱娜]
如果你有時間，請明天再來。我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
I think this is enough for today, please come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
